heroHeadline: Reports Raise Concerns Over President Tinubu's Health and Governing Capacity
heroSubtitle: Circulating reports about President Tinubu's health are raising questions about his capacity to govern amid Nigeria's ongoing economic and security crises. Tinubu returned from an extended stay in London and Paris on September 29, asserting he was healthy, but fresh concerns have emerged.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Nigerian government records, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are contested and drawn from multiple independent sources.
